items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: he played with Jones for a while

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . When was the Young Tuxedo? When was the Young Tuxedo Brass Band founded? What age? Was that after Landry died or before he died?
That was before he died because he played with Jones for a while. Yeah, that was before he died.
But the Tulane had kind of broken up.
